segments.en: Who bears his soul toward the most awesome wisdom of the Nachal Noavaya Mekor Chuchma — who has promised us that through him the Torah will not be forgotten from Israel. …And even more so — he hones his eyes and gnashes his teeth against all who wish to labor even a little — within the palace of the King — the King of Israel and their Redeemer from generation to generation — the Nachal Noavaya.
